economic_rationale: Stop-loss research predicts value only under persistent returns and warns that costs can erase it. This frozen passive-core screen is valuable only if a fixed 20-percent trailing-peak loss state preserves at least 70 percent of buy-and-hold upside after costs while materially reducing drawdown, improving Calmar and surviving annual and 15/25-percent threshold breadth. Lower exposure by itself cannot pass.
opportunity_cost: One frozen direct screen tests a distinct current trailing-peak loss-state passive-core mechanism on the existing sealed corpus and fractional ledger. A failure closes it before threshold tuning or runtime engineering consumes more capacity.
stop_conditions: Stop with DATA_REJECT before economics if any source hash, dataset hash, hourly lattice, OHLCV or complete UTC-day gate fails.

Stop with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT before economics if latest-close versus trailing-365-complete-day maximum, threshold equality, state-change-only fractional rebalancing or next-open availability is ambiguous.
Stop and permanently close the exact daily trailing365d drawdown15/20/25 100/50 passive-core family if the primary or either rejection-only neighbor fails any frozen gate.
Do not select a neighbor after seeing outcomes even if it outperforms the primary.
Do not scan another drawdown lookback, threshold, reference peak, target exposure, equality, rebalance frequency, delay, holding rule, stop, DRA combination or cost model after results.
Do not use post-2024 data; a pass may only become CANDIDATE_FROZEN_REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED with one independent sealed OOS still required.
thesis: A causal completed-day trailing-365-day drawdown overlay can retain a permanent half-size BTC core while reducing the other half during persistent cumulative-loss states, improving after-cost risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.

distinct_from_closed_families: Unlike closed Ulcer21/28/35, this feature is the current close drawdown from a fixed trailing-365-day maximum and uses no squared drawdown average, short duration window or lagged median.

Unlike closed DRA 90-day drawdown-recovery admission, this is a standalone whole-portfolio 100/50 exposure overlay and uses no first peak, post-peak trough, recovery fraction, discrete-lot gate or DRA interaction.
Unlike closed daily SMA trend timing, this policy never goes fully to cash and uses no moving average, oscillator, channel, band or forecast score.
excluded_reinterpretations: Minus 20 percent is primary; minus 15 and minus 25 percent are rejection-only neighbors and cannot replace it.
No alternate lookback, threshold, relation, exposure, equality, rebalance frequency, delay, holding rule, stop, leverage, short leg, DRA interaction or ensemble may be scanned after outcome access.
A historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and still requires one independent sealed OOS.
